"""Compute count, mean, and median of the numbers in data.txt (one per line)."""

from pathlib import Path
from statistics import mean, median

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent

numbers = []
for line in (HERE / "data.txt").read_text().splitlines():
    line = line.strip()
    if not line:
        continue
    numbers.append(int(line) if line.lstrip("+-").isdigit() else float(line))

stats = {
    "count": len(numbers),
    "mean": mean(numbers),
    "median": median(numbers),
}

(HERE / "stats.txt").write_text("".join(f"{k}: {v}\n" for k, v in stats.items()))
